subject: Cohort headcount redistribution & comp-band harmonization
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: redistribute two open eng reqs to Q4 priority; align bands

Hi all,

Finance flagged a near-term hiring freeze that will take effect Sep 1 if we don't absorb headcount into Q4 commitments. To avoid losing momentum on two critical backend eng roles (GH-REQ-4521, GH-REQ-4528) I propose a temporary cohort reallocation: move these two reqs from Q3 to Q4 priority but reserve the offers for August candidates who are staged now.

Key asks:
- Quick read/approve the proposed redistribution in the attached spreadsheet (headcount_realloc_q3_q4.xlsx).
- Guidance on comp-band harmonization for any offers we push: can we provide up to a 7% band carve for mission-critical hires without VP sign-off?
- If any manager needs an exception, please attach the completed exception_request_template.docx and route to Vivek.

I realize this is fast — happy to jump on a 20-min sync. TL;DR: temporary pause + limited exceptions process to protect active candidates.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: headcount_realloc_q3_q4.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute two open eng reqs to Q4 priority; align bands

Priyom —

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the sheet; redistributing the two backend reqs to Q4 is fine provided we can push offers to our two shortlisted candidates this week. One flag on comp bands: both candidates benchmark at top of IC4. If we push an off-cycle offer I’ll likely need a band harmonization (IC4 -> IC5) to make it competitive.

If the policy limits us to 7% and the market requires ~12% total comp uplift, I’ll request a band exception. Can Marissa advise on precedent?

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Eng Manager, Backend
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute two open eng reqs to Q4 priority; align bands

Looping in because sales will also feel downstream effects if we don’t backfill an AE soon. There’s a high-fit candidate (Sara Lee, previously at Acme Health) in pipeline — if we can extend offer before the freeze she’s likely to accept.

Two asks from my side:
1) Can we carve out a single AE role from the freeze under the same exception path?
2) If we need exec approval, can we fast-track? Time is the variable here — candidate is evaluative with other offers.

I can prep a short one-pager for the VP if it helps.

Thanks,
Aditya
Sr. Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute two open eng reqs to Q4 priority; align bands

Thanks — summarizing a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear steps:

1) Freeze effective date: Sep 1, 2027. Open reqs will be paused in Greenhouse for active intake after that date unless exception approved.
2) Exception path: managers submit exception_request_template.docx -> People Ops (Marissa) -> Finance (Vivek) -> VP sign-off if increase > +10% comp or band change.
3) Pipeline safelisting: candidates with offer-ready status (offer packet queued in GH) can be extended between Aug 16–20 if People Ops approves the exception log entry.
4) Compensation cap: default 7% uplift without VP review; band change requires VP approval.
5) All exceptions will be recorded in approved_exceptions_log.csv maintained by Marissa.

Attachments: exception_request_template.docx

If that plan is acceptable I’ll coordinate with recruiting to start offer packets for Sara Lee and the two backend candidates tomorrow morning.

Priyom

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute two open eng reqs to Q4 priority; align bands

Quick clarifications from Finance/Comp:

- We can allow up to +7% one-time uplift without VP approval, consistent with the temp policy. Any band promotion (IC4 -> IC5) that increases base or OTE beyond the band ceiling requires VP sign-off.
- Please include the total FTE delta (net headcount change this FY) in the exception request; Finance needs to model the run-rate impact.
- Use the band-adjustment-lookup tab in the shared Google sheet to map comp targets.
- Route approvals via the #finance-headcount Slack channel for visibility; use the template to capture comp rationale.

FYI: Dedicated budget lines (e.g., Dedicated compute hiring) are treated slightly differently — flag if roles charge to a dedicated pool.

Vivek
VP, Finance & People Analytics
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: redistribute two open eng reqs to Q4 priority; align bands

All —

People Ops has reviewed the exception requests and we can greenlight two exceptions this cycle:
1) Backend Hiring: one IC4->IC5 band exception for candidate in GH-REQ-4521 (Laura’s req) — approved subject to written justification and candidate comp packet.
2) Sales AE: single AE role exception for Aditya — approved up to +7% uplift (no band promotion).

I attached the current approved_exceptions_log.csv and added entries — please update with final comps once offers are finalized.

Notes:
- For any VP-level band elevation requests, please route to Vivek with the completed template.
- Recruiting: please cc recruiting@redwood.com when sending offer emails so we maintain the pipeline audit.

Marissa Cole
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: approved_exceptions_log.csv
